pages.title: Elena Rossi – Freelance Photographer
pages.html:
Elena Rossi 📷

Elena Rossi – Freelance Photographer

Capturing moments, telling stories. Specialized in portrait, landscape, and event photography.

About Me

With over 8 years of experience in professional photography, I've had the privilege of working with diverse clients across Italy and Europe. My approach combines technical precision with artistic vision, ensuring every shot tells a compelling story.

I specialize in:

  • Portrait Photography – Capturing personality and emotion in every frame
  • Landscape Photography – Revealing the beauty of natural environments
  • Event Photography – Documenting weddings, corporate events, and celebrations
  • Commercial Photography – Professional product and architectural shots

I work with both digital and film, and I'm passionate about post-processing that enhances rather than transforms. Let's create something beautiful together.
